improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon is, who it serves, and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the pricing anchor and free searches creates urgency without overselling.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while addressing the target audience directly. Ending with the free trial offer and 'no card required' removes friction and encourages immediate engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's full capabilities—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model: what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition and reinforcing value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces uncertainty and positions the paywall as an upgrade rather than a barrier. Mentioning the annual savings incentivizes longer commitment.
